source_metadata.title: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus Necrotizing Pneumonia
source_metadata.source_type: Letter / single-patient case report with molecular isolate characterization

extraction_limitations: Single-patient letter/case report; no control group, prespecified endpoints, or inferential statistics.
The PDF page contains adjacent letters in neighboring columns; only the Monaco et al. article on pages 1647-1648 was extracted.

The print PDF contains a published linezolid dosing error (600 mg three times daily). The official CDC erratum corrected the regimen to 600 mg twice daily. To avoid propagating a known publication error, the exact dose was excluded from LiteratureAtom exposure fields; the treatment timing and duration were retained.
No funding statement, conflict-of-interest statement, data-availability statement, figures, tables, or supplements are present for this letter in the supplied PDF.
All language-model-extracted atoms remain review_status=needs_review; human verification was not invented.

external_verification.purpose: Published erratum verification only; not used to replace source-derived case findings.
external_verification.official_correction: Emerging Infectious Diseases 2005;11(11):1808 corrected the linezolid dose on page 1647 from 600 mg three times daily to 600 mg twice daily.
